insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Hospital Cash is a daily lump-sum benefit, not indemnity. Child Birth Hospital Cash waiting period 24 months from first commencement.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Daily Hospital Cash on lump-sum basis (Rs 1,000 to Rs 3,000+/day)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Pays daily benefit for hospitalization due to illness/sickness/injury; supplements indemnity policies for incidental expenses (travel, food).

day_care_treatments.notes: Only triggers on hospitalization with overnight stay.

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Child Birth Hospital Cash (Enhanced Plan only)

disease_wise_sub_limits.convalescence_cash_benefit: Enhanced Plan: 1 additional Hospital Cash amount if hospitalization beyond 5 consecutive days

permanent_exclusions: Convalescence, general debility, rest cure, nutritional deficiency
Substance abuse, drugs/alcohol, smoking, tobacco chewing
War, invasion, foreign enemy, warlike operations
HIFU, Uterine Fibroid Embolisation, Balloon Sinoplasty, EECP, Chelation, Deep Brain Stimulation, HBOT, RFQMR, VAX-D
Stem Cell Therapy, Chondrocyte Implantation, PRP, intra-articular injections
Cosmetic/Aesthetic treatment, erectile dysfunction, Change of Sex
notable_exclusions_summary: Daily cash payout supplement; excludes pregnancy/cosmetic/congenital/substance-abuse cases and a long list of specific procedures. Hospitalization with overnight stay required.
claim_process_summary: Submit claim form + discharge summary + hospital bill + KYC + NEFT. Helpline 044-69006900, toll-free 1800 425 2255.
top_rider_examples: Enhanced Plan with Convalescence + Child Birth Cash
